scripts.lint: biome lint . && node --experimental-strip-types ../../node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config . && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-boundary.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:dependencies && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/copy-sql.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.contracts.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=45000 .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.example: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test-dist/examples/usage.js
